The complete reference build in 600 +/- 60 second fights with seed 7: repeated Evocations and every cooldown cycling.

The application's Arcane reference request (ReferenceBuildBySlug arcane-mage with BuildRequest at application revision ad6ea6b8, timeline on), unchanged: Undead with Touch of the Grave, Ignite talented, Arcane Blast, Arcane Power and Presence of Mind.

The application's Arcane reference without Missile Barrage. Regression for community fix #622: the preset's unguarded Arcane Missiles rule makes pinned Go cast Missiles whenever reached (449.7 DPS, no Arcane Blasts) where the fix reads the aura as inactive (396.6 DPS).

cases.description: The application's Fire character as a Human without Ignite, Heating Up, Master of Elements or Combustion, casting Fire Blast and Scorch: Improved Scorch stacks Fire Vulnerability on the mage.
The fire-scorch character casting Fire Blast and Fireball: the hit lands after travel, then the dot snapshots and ticks on current spell power and multipliers.
The same with Scorch while Fire Vulnerability has fewer than five stacks: the stacks change under running Fireball dots.
The fire-fireball-scorch case with Master of Elements: crits refund part of the base cost, at most once per internal cooldown.
The Master of Elements case with Heating Up and the reference's Pyroblast rule: crits stack a Pyroblast cast time cut, and Pyroblast at three stacks spends them, then its own dot snapshots.
The Heating Up case with Combustion and the reference's Combustion and cooldown rules: each landed Fire hit adds crit until three crits end the buff and start the cooldown.
The Combustion case with Ignite: Fire crits pay a share of their damage over Ignite's ticks, and a crit while the dot runs rolls what it still owes into the new dot.

The application's Fire reference request (ReferenceBuildBySlug fire-mage with BuildRequest at application revision ad6ea6b8, timeline on), unchanged: a Gnome with Eureka!, Scorch, Fireball, Fire Blast, Pyroblast, Heating Up, Combustion, Ignite and Master of Elements.
The Frost reference as a Troll: Berserking, a major cooldown that multiplies cast speed for 10 seconds.
The Frost reference as a Troll in 600-second fights: Berserking expires and is cast again, and every mana cooldown fires.
The Frost reference as an Orc: Blood Fury multiplies spell damage and attack power for 15 seconds; Shatter Curse, a survival cooldown, never fires on its own.
The Frost reference as an Orc in 300-second fights with configured cooldown timings: Shatter Curse is cast at 10 and 200 seconds, Blood Fury at 30 and 160 seconds and then whenever ready.
The Frost reference as a High Order Skyborne: one percent cast speed and Elemental slaying are static; Read Ley Line is cast only by a rotation action, and this rotation has none.
The Fire reference as a High Order Skyborne whose rotation casts Read Ley Line below 60% mana: a two-second cast whose aura Energized doubles mana regeneration for 15 seconds.
